program.section_heading: ACE - Advanced Certificate for ESL Noncredit
outcomes: Integrate form and usage to produce and understand level-appropriate written and oral English discourse following language conventions, and using acceptable grammatical forms, word order and purpose.

Devise meaning accurately from aural discourse and orally construct sociolinguistically appropriate and accurate language for community, vocational, and academic functions using authentic, level-appropriate language and skills.
Decode, comprehend, and analyze English texts applying lexical and reading skills and strategies for intensive and extensive purposes.
Compose level-appropriate academic writing in English applying developmental, organizational, grammatical, lexical and mechanical skills through the use of the writing process.
Expand English language skills for workplace and community needs.

notes: The page prints a credit Skills Certificate (ESL 0025G, 0025L, 0025C; 12 units) under the same ACE name; this record reads only the Noncredit Certificate of Competency section.

The noncredit section counts in units and prints 0 for each course and 'Total Units 0'; no hours are printed for this certificate or its courses. The course descriptions for ESL 0840C/0840L/0842G are cut off in the text, so their hours could not be read. Measure left as 'units' with the printed 0 values; a reviewer may wish to confirm hours from the course descriptions.
The Program Student Learning Outcomes appear on the department page's outcomes tab as a single list, not specific to this certificate; recorded here as shared by this award.
No careers are named for this program.
